services.value: Provides administrative information including vital records access, budgeting, and fee schedules; clinical services such as immunizations, screenings (breast and cervical cancer), dental care, family planning, and general health services including A1C testing, anemia testing, blood pressure checks, and cholesterol screening. Also provides community resources, emergency services information, environmental quality programs (air and water quality, waste management, and regulatory resources), health events and classes, permits and inspections, and WIC services.
